races.name: 4 x 4 Tyres Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Hopefully the ground doesn't dry out too much for TRINITY STREET, who looks the one to beat with sights lowered on return. Well-related Rosie Mahler may follow her home if improving as entitled from her debut effort, while Capricciose could be the pick of the hurdling newcomers.

  1. TRINITY STREET (IRE)
  2. ROSIE MAHLER (IRE)
  3. CAPRICCIOSE (IRE)

races.name: EBF And Charlie Longsdon Racing 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
RED METAL has an experience edge over the other main protagonists and may well defy a penalty for his impressive C&D success. Hurdling debutants Brecharnon and Smile John Boy both command serious respect.

  1. RED METAL (FR)
  2. BRECHARNON (FR)
  3. SMILE JOHN BOY (IRE)

races.name: EBF And Charlie Longsdon Racing 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Successful in a Grade 2 bumper that has already produced multiple winning hurdle debutants, FORTHFACTOR should be a class above on first start over hurdles. Bebe And Bean, Emerald Tir and Rock On Ronnie all have potential but are likely bumping into one here.

  1. FORTHFACTOR (IRE)
  2. BEBE AND BEAN
  3. EMERALD TIR

races.name: Blaze A Trail Stratford Hat-Trick Hero Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHURCHMAN's best effort of last season came when runner-up over C&D, and he's taken to break his duck on return for an in-form yard. Drakaris looks interesting sent handicapping by the Skeltons, especially if supported. Little Pi is a solid operator at this level and rates another likely danger in a competitive handicap.

  1. CHURCHMAN
  2. DRAKARIS (IRE)
  3. LITTLE PI (FR)

races.name: Happy Birthday Penny Tyacke Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A warm-looking race in which the market will likely prove useful but GATINEAU PARK did well over hurdles last season and this former point winner firmly appeals as the type to make an even better chaser. He could be worth siding with for a yard amongst the winners. Jipcot has more races in him from his present mark and is feared along with George's Lad. Aintree scorer Mr Hope Street is another to note for all this trip may be on the short side on seasonal bow.

  1. GATINEAU PARK (IRE)
  2. JIPCOT (FR)
  3. GEORGE'S LAD (IRE)

races.name: J.H. Rowe Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ITHAKA followed his breakthrough win over fences with a trio of non-completions, but it's reasonable to assume he can bounce back now setting out for a new yard which is in rude health. Moor End was all out to hold on at Chepstow when last seen in March but goes well fresh and should remain competitive from only 2 lb higher in the weights. Fellow last-time-out winner Pescatorius is also feared, for all that this is a tougher assignment.

  1. ITHAKA (IRE)
  2. MOOR END (IRE)
  3. PESCATORIUS (IRE)

races.name: Charlotte Cole And Becky Rowland Memorial Fillies' 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IGNITE THE NIGHT fits the bill on paper for a yard which does very well in bumpers, so she earns the vote before market clues. Lady Loki is another with an appealing Flat pedigree for an emerging stable, while Dance In The Mist and And So It Begins are also likely types to note in the betting.

  1. IGNITE THE NIGHT
  2. LADY LOKI
  3. DANCE IN THE MIST

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARCADIAN STAR sets a fair standard and may add another success to Stuart Edmunds' recent haul. Paul Nicholls' The Final Word is feared most if building on his hurdling debut promise at the second attempt. The market should offer plenty of clues regarding the hurdling debutants, with Justalargewhisky, Barrow Hill Lad and Walk Of Faith all potentially interesting.

  1. ARCADIAN STAR (IRE)
  2. THE FINAL WORD (IRE)
  3. JUSTALARGEWHISKY (FR)

races.name: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PASSAGE GUENOT has transferred to powerful connections after finishing runner-up on his sole outing in Irish points back in the spring and makes plenty of appeal in what looks a winnable maiden. Kimai is another interesting recruit from the Irish-pointing field, having won on her second start in that sphere and joined a promising yard. Elusive Pb can prove best of the rest.

  1. PASSAGE GUENOT (FR)
  2. KIMAI (IRE)
  3. ELUSIVE PB

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
UGO BINGO readily capitalised on a career-low mark at Chepstow earlier this month and looks capable of following up for a yard among the winners. It's Easy may prove the main threat if in the same form as on her reappearance last week.

  1. UGO BINGO (FR)
  2. IT'S EASY (FR)
  3. HELLFIRE PRINCESS

races.name: Golwg Gwendraeth Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Class-dropper BOYLES HILL gets the nod in an interesting race for the grade. Berkshire Smudge, Whatsgoingonmarvin and Lully Du Houx are all relatively unexposed in handicaps and may well be capable of better.

  1. BOYLES HILL (IRE)
  2. BERKSHIRE SMUDGE (IRE)
  3. WHATSGOINGONMARVIN (IRE)

races.name: Walters Group NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
VERNEY FOX takes the eye on pedigree and, having changed hands for €145,000 after finishing runner-up on his sole outing in Irish points, he makes obvious appeal and is taken to provide Paul Nicholls with a first bumper winner of the season. Goodbye Earl and De Inovator are 2 others to note.

  1. VERNEY FOX (IRE)
  2. GOODBYE EARL (IRE)
  3. DE INOVATOR (IRE)

races.name: Walters Group Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FAIRYE FORTH made an encouraging start to his hurdling career back in the spring and strikes as the type to do even better now sent chasing/handicapping up in trip given his pointing background, so he's an appealing candidate. Mountain Mike remains relatively unexposed over fences and needs considering on his return to action, while Loki's Mischief is worth another chance having shaped as if amiss in a strong-looking race at Worcester last month.

  1. FAIRYE FORTH (IRE)
  2. MOUNTAIN MIKE (IRE)
  3. LOKI'S MISCHIEF (FR)

races.name: Dai Walters Trophy Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FILANDERER has been successful on both previous tries over fences here, latterly when making a winning reappearance in this race 12 months ago and he's likely been well prepared for a repeat bid reunited with Sean Bowen. That said, this is competitive, with Toothless and Just Over Land fancied to play leading roles also.

  1. FILANDERER
  2. TOOTHLESS (FR)
  3. JUST OVER LAND (FR)

races.name: David Cole Memorial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
The opener can go the way of LADY PHILLIPS, who went like the best horse at the weights when going close at Leicester on debut. She looks to hold leading claims with the biggest threat possibly coming from a pair of the newcomers, Roos Racing Rocket the pick for second ahead of Buxted Flyer.

  1. LADY PHILLIPS
  2. ROOS RACING ROCKET (IRE)
  3. BUXTED FLYER (FR)

races.name: David Cole Memorial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SPACE BOB shaped well on debut when staying on for second at Nottingham earlier this month and, with improvement to come, he would be fancied to go one better if taking up this engagement. Divine Rhythm is much respected, though, after also showing promise on his first start, while Consortium boasts an eye-catching pedigree.

  1. SPACE BOB (IRE)
  2. DIVINE RHYTHM (IRE)
  3. CONSORTIUM

races.name: Bath Luxury Toilet Hire Nursery
races.verdict:
KAITO showed why he had been well backed on nursery debut the time before when getting off the mark in good style over this C&D and he can score again with further progress to come. He gets the vote ahead of Ground Force, who also carries a penalty for his recent success, with Q T Boy completing the shortlist.

  1. KAITO
  2. GROUND FORCE
  3. Q T BOY

races.name: Disability INC Handicap
races.verdict:
EQUION took advantage of a career-low mark when scoring on soft ground at Ffos Las in September and, having not been seen to best effect since, he can add to his tally with conditions to suit. Lovely Jubly was successful under testing conditions here last year and is next on the list, ahead of Kaleidoscope Eyes.

  1. EQUION
  2. LOVELY JUBLY
  3. KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE)

races.name: Thank You To Our Loyal Annual Members Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for SERGEI BREEZE, who had been going the right way prior to having excuses at Sandown on his latest outing. The lightly-raced 3-y-o is taken to resume his progress and open his account, at the chief expense of 6-time course winner Albus Anne. Newtown Duke completes the shortlist.

  1. SERGEI BREEZE
  2. ALBUS ANNE
  3. NEWTOWN DUKE (IRE)

races.name: Oakenson Ltd Handicap
races.verdict:
PEDROS DREAM confirmed the improvement he showed on handicap debut when runner-up here last time, despite having not been seen to best effect, and he could be ready to get off the mark. Nogo's Dream remains on a handy mark and is capable of being in the mix once more, along with Kiss And Run who has conditions to suit.

  1. PEDROS DREAM
  2. NOGO'S DREAM
  3. KISS AND RUN

races.name: Bristol Motor Club Handicap
races.verdict:
UNICO was the subject of strong support and looked unfortunate not to reward her backers when finishing third behind reopposing Roman Spring at Brighton 2 weeks ago, finishing well having conceded first run. She's fancied to confirm the promise of that effort from an unchanged mark. Whiteley Way, Up The Anti and aforementioned Roman Spring are a trio of others to consider.

  1. UNICO
  2. WHITELEY WAY
  3. UP THE ANTI (IRE)

races.name: MJ Church Handicap
races.verdict:
Course winner LEGENDSOFTHELAND has been much improved this season, winning for the third time at Ffos Las in July. He's remained in good form of late, unlucky not to finish closer when fourth at Nottingham on his latest outing 2 weeks ago. He shades preference over Iconic Dawn who looks worthy of a crack at the minimum trip. In-form 5-y-o Call Time and last year's winner Lahina Bay are others to consider.

  1. LEGENDSOFTHELAND (IRE)
  2. ICONIC DAWN
  3. CALL TIME (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
ANTHROPOLOGIST had plenty up his sleeve when successful over 7f here on Saturday and hopes are high that he will defy a penalty. Timely Affair and Exotic Baby head the opposition.

  1. ANTHROPOLOGIST
  2. TIMELY AFFAIR
  3. EXOTIC BABY

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This should concern 3, with BEAUJON taken to build on the clear promise of his Kempton debut 3 weeks ago with most from his stable improving from first to second run. Shadow Boxer and the penalised Sin City should make it interesting.

  1. BEAUJON (FR)
  2. SHADOW BOXER (FR)
  3. SIN CITY

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
Stall 12 could have been kinder but SON OF LIGHT could be the answer on this quick switch to nurseries after 2 encouraging runs. From Me To You and Tarn Hows also have something to recommend them.

  1. SON OF LIGHT (IRE)
  2. FROM ME TO YOU (IRE)
  3. TARN HOWS

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DISTILLATE is going through a good spell at present, making it back-to-back C&D wins with a clear-cut success 10 days ago, and she looks to hold leading claims without a penalty for that latest victory. The biggest threat could come from Keep Me Stable who has dropped to a career-low mark, ahead of Edmond Halley.

  1. DISTILLATE
  2. KEEP ME STABLE (IRE)
  3. EDMOND HALLEY (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
There's every chance that MINI MAC can defy a penalty and make it a quick-fire double for James Owen. Ardaddy and Coulsty Exchange head the dangers in an open-looking handicap.

  1. MINI MAC (IRE)
  2. ARDADDY
  3. COULSTY EXCHANGE (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
Course winner YORKSHIRE was caught wider than ideal last time and looks well worth another chance off a 3 lb lower mark. First Legion could have a big say if translating his recent turf form to all-weather, while it'll be no surprise to see Storm Free bounce back on return to this track (1-1).

  1. YORKSHIRE (IRE)
  2. FIRST LEGION (IRE)
  3. STORM FREE

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
SEVENKINGSMUSTDIE continued a theme of gradual progression when opening his account in game fashion at Wolverhampton 4 weeks ago and a token 2 lb rise can see Alan King's low-mileage 4-y-o highly competitive again now his stamina is tested further. Sycamore Gap revived when making a successful stable debut over C&D last week and is feared, as is another last-time-out C&D scorer Fleur de Mer.

  1. SEVENKINGSMUSTDIE (IRE)
  2. SYCAMORE GAP
  3. FLEUR DE MER (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty of in-form fillies in opposition but KASHOODA goes handicapping from what looks a workable opening mark and in leading hands, it would come as no surprise to see her take a step forward. Midnight Media comes here thriving and is an obvious threat, with Time To Sparkle and Molo del Palazzo a couple of others worthy of respect.

  1. KASHOODA
  2. MIDNIGHT MEDIA
  3. TIME TO SPARKLE

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
COBALT COMET hasn't been the most consistent to date but he did well to split a pair ridden closer to the pace when second at Wolverhampton 31 days ago and could just be worth chancing to build on that from a 1 lb higher mark. Sea The Light bounced back to form in no uncertain terms when forging clear at Wolverhampton 10 days ago and he's a big player under a penalty. Meet Me In Meraki back on a left-handed track and Harlington are others to consider.

  1. COBALT COMET
  2. SEA THE LIGHT (IRE)
  3. MEET ME IN MERAKI

races.name: Race 3 - Al Maqam Classic Maiden Stakes
Race 5 - Wathba Stallions Cup Handicap (for Private Owners)
Prix Du Theatre Imperial Du Chateau De Fontainebleau Chase
Prix De La Route Des 2 Soeurs (chmpt Paris Turf Des App. & J. Jock.) Claiming Hurdle
Prix Comte Antoine De Gontaut-biron Hurdle
Prix Du Massif Forestier Claiming Hurdle
Prix Jean Laborde Listed Arab Stakes
Grande Course De Haies De Bordeaux Handicap Hurdle
Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
This is a lot easier than the Group 3 WUNDERSCHON contested at Leopardstown 12 days ago and she can make her experience tell back in a maiden. Petticoat Bay looks a sure-fire improver, with San Juan de Lope an appealing debutante.

  1. WUNDERSCHON (GER)
  2. PETTICOAT BAY (USA)
  3. SAN JUAN DE LOPE (IRE)

races.name: Punchestown Premiere Weekend Sat 21 & Sun 22 November Handicap
races.verdict:
JP'S EXPRESS ran a career best when third in a big-field handicap at the Curragh 2 weeks ago and a repeat of that should see him right on the premises again. San Aer and Earls are both on lengthy losing runs but lurk on a very dangerous mark as a result.

  1. JP'S EXPRESS (IRE)
  2. SAN AER (IRE)
  3. EARLS (IRE)

races.name: Win A Trip To Lapland At Punchestown On Sun 22 November Maiden
races.verdict:
NONSENSE is bred to be useful and while he was sent off at 33/1, his debut at the Curragh was full of promise. Expected to build on that, he may get the better of the Aidan O'Brien trio, with Oklahoma probably the pick of them.

  1. NONSENSE
  2. OKLAHOMA (USA)
  3. IMPOSING (IRE)

races.name: Premiere Weekend Race & Dine Packages From 75 Euros Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
WECOULDAVEHADITALL wasn't in top form back in maiden company 3 weeks ago but this looks a nursery there for the taking from her current mark. Margot Mae will find this easier than the nursery she contested at Leopardstown last time and she's feared most.

  1. WECOULDAVEHADITALL (IRE)
  2. MARGOT MAE (IRE)
  3. GABBY HAYES (IRE)

races.name: Premiere Weekend Two-Day Ticket Just 35 Euros Maiden
races.verdict:
SPACEBOUND has garnered more experience than most of these and having shaped well in a handicap 3 weeks ago, he looks the answer dropped in distance. Saliba and Oracle of Delphi are feared most.

  1. SPACEBOUND
  2. SALIBA (IRE)
  3. ORACLE OF DELPHI (IRE)

races.name: See You At The GR1 Double Header 21 & 22 November Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TAI TAM BAY's strike rate will put some off but she shaped nicely on return from a break at the Curragh 2 weeks ago and is too well weighted to ignore. Free Solo and La Tulipe Noire head the opposition.

  1. TAI TAM BAY (IRE)
  2. FREE SOLO (IRE)
  3. LA TULIPE NOIRE (IRE)

races.name: See You At The GR1 Double Header 21 & 22 November Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
REAL PETITE turned a big-field handicap into a one-sided affair at Gowran 10 days ago and on that evidence, her revised mark may well be within reach. Pocket Jacks was also impressive when scoring at Dundalk on Wednesday and is a huge danger if allowed to take her chance. Buttermere Ridge is also of some interest.

  1. REAL PETITE (GER)
  2. POCKET JACKS (IRE)
  3. BUTTERMERE RIDGE (IRE)
